meta.name: data-engineering
meta.description: Builds and operates data pipelines — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, quality testing, and reliability of data delivery. Use this to design or debug a pipeline, decide batch versus streaming, add data quality checks, handle late or duplicate data, or work out why a dashboard's numbers changed without anyone changing the dashboard.

copy.tagline: 整合分散数据,让报表数字稳定可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果报表数字经常对不上,你总在猜数据为何变化
copy.tagline_en: Automate data flows to keep reports accurate and reliable
copy.fit_line_en: For you if reports often show wrong numbers and you're always figuring out why

howto.what: 装了这个技能，Claude会按数据工程规则来帮忙：建议保留原始数据、把业务转换放在下游、让任务重复运行也不重复计算，并提醒检查数据质量，发现不对就停止发布，不要悄悄出错。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计/调试数据管道、决定批处理还是流式、或排查数据质量与异常问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计从RDS同步到数据仓库的管道，用批处理还是流式？
say.note: 会先确认数据量与时效要求再给建议。

say.text: 管道重跑会不会重复计数？帮我检查幂等性。
say.note: 会分析重跑逻辑并给出防重复方案。

say.text: 仪表板数字变了但没人改仪表板，帮我查一下管道。
say.note: 会排查延迟、重复与时间窗口等根因。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude applies data-engineering principles: keep raw data as received, move business logic downstream, make reruns idempotent, and verify data quality, failing loudly rather than publishing unreliable data.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks to design or debug a data pipeline, choose between batch and streaming, or investigate data-quality or anomaly issues.

say_en.text: Should I use batch or streaming for a pipeline syncing RDS to the warehouse?
say_en.note: It will ask for volume/latency needs first.

say_en.text: Would a rerun double-count? Check this pipeline's idempotency.
say_en.note: It will review rerun logic and suggest anti-duplication fixes.

say_en.text: Dashboard numbers changed but no one edited it—is it the pipeline?
say_en.note: It will check delays, duplicates, and time windows.
